$comment: Hand-written schema parity snapshot of spec 02 §1.2–§7 for M0 (tables transcribed from the spec text; policies from §5/§5.1; grants from §1.2; functions from §6 and the §5.2 integrity triggers). schema-parity.int.test.ts compares the migrated catalog with it.

checks: NOT enabled OR active_version IS NOT NULL
active_version IS NULL OR active_version <= revision
candidate_version IS NULL OR candidate_version <= revision
merged_into_id IS NULL OR (merged_into_id <> id AND status = 'dead')

feed_items_guid_idx.definition: (feed_id, md5(guid)) WHERE guid IS NOT NULL

checks: (level = 1 AND parent_id IS NULL) OR (level = 2 AND parent_id IS NOT NULL)
parent_id IS NULL OR parent_id <> id
previous_card_id IS NULL OR previous_card_id <> card_id

job_outbox_dedupe_idx.definition: (queue, dedupe_key) WHERE delivered_at IS NULL AND dedupe_key IS NOT NULL

checks: status <> 'complete' OR result_snapshot IS NOT NULL
expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > requested_at
status NOT IN ('approved','rejected') OR responded_at IS NOT NULL
authorization_kind <> 'creator_approval' OR responded_at IS NOT NULL
kind <> 'mute_story' OR expires_at IS NOT NULL
bookmarked_at IS NOT NULL OR (bookmark_snapshot_id IS NULL AND bookmark_capture_status IS NULL AND bookmark_origin_feed_id IS NULL)
bookmark_capture_status NOT IN ('saved','partial') OR bookmark_snapshot_id IS NOT NULL
reason IS NULL OR (rating IS NOT NULL AND rating = -1)

user_article_lane_idx.definition: (user_id, lane, p_like DESC NULLS LAST, article_id DESC) WHERE archived_at IS NULL AND read_at IS NULL

user_article_bookmarks_idx.definition: (user_id, bookmarked_at DESC) WHERE bookmarked_at IS NOT NULL

policies.name: interest_cards_read
policies.using: visibility IN ('public','shared') OR owner_user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid

policies.name: interest_cards_create
policies.withCheck: nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '') IS NOT NULL AND ((visibility = 'shared' AND origin = 'user' AND owner_user_id IS NULL AND creator_user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid) OR (visibility = 'private' AND origin = 'fork' AND creator_user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid AND owner_user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid) OR (visibility = 'public' AND origin = 'library' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid AND role = 'admin' AND deleted_at IS NULL)))

policies.name: interest_cards_update
policies.using: visibility IN ('public','shared') OR owner_user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid
policies.withCheck: visibility IN ('public','shared') OR owner_user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid

policies.name: card_answers_read
policies.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM interest_cards c WHERE c.id = card_id)

policies.name: article_snapshots_saved_read
policies.using: EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_article ua WHERE ua.bookmark_snapshot_id = article_snapshots.id AND ua.bookmarked_at IS NOT NULL AND ua.user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bookmark_snapshot_pins p WHERE p.snapshot_id = article_snapshots.id AND p.expires_at > now() AND p.user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid )

admin_activate_provider_credential.args: p_provider text, p_expected_revision bigint, p_candidate_version bigint
